719-1168-3510-8168.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Xenograft.
719-1168-3510-8168.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each permanent that entered is a Saproling through Xenograft and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Toggo to trigger.
Resolve a Toggo trigger, replacing the artifact token creation with that many 5/5 Dragons through Draconic Visitor.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

883-4279-7316--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
883-4279-7316--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent, Rat King and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Rat King ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

4419-4694-4779-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4419-4694-4779-7306.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability, giving it +1/+0 and first strike until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

3558-3661-6516-7735.description:

Repeat.

862-3661-5049-6516.easyPrerequisites:

862-3661-5049-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

1879-6006-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1879-6006-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1879-6006-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

283-4186-5189-7426.description:
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature, targeting Scurry Oak
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Ghave's ability, targeting Berta.
Resolve the first Ghave ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Resolve the second Ghave ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1376-7500.notablePrerequisites: There are at least six Elves on the battlefield.
1376-7500.description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Activate Ringing Strike Mastery by paying {5}, untapping Priest of Titania.
Repeat.

1988-2438-3490-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
1988-2438-3490-7426.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Blade of the Bloodchief triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat

703-3388-7149.description:
Cast Moritte of the Frost by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Moritte of the Frost into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Moritte of the Frost dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Astral Dragon, gaining its abilities.
When Moritte of the Frost enters, it triggers, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Put all but one of the Moritte of the Frosts into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Moritte of the Frost tokens each trigger. Resolve a trigger, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 5.
703-3388-7149.notes: The additional triggers can copy whatever noncreature permanent(s) you desire.

1233-5147-7124.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
1233-5147-7124.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Squee as attackers.
Squee triggers, creating a creature token.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a creature token, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

7-4907-5686-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-4907-5686-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Hamza. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

225-5702-5954-7288.easyPrerequisites:
Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
225-5702-5954-7288.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the Everywhere token.
Activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
Groundchuck & Dirtbag triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5315-6972-7153.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Arcbound Bruiser.
When Arcbound Bruiser dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Bruiser's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Bruiser from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

2281-3817-4050.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Saffi triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

2511-4681-5170-6094.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

323-4681-5170-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1682-2366-5223-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1682-2366-5223-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Dictate of Karametra triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

3557-5963-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
3557-5963-7009.description:
Activate Marvin using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Brago. Brago triggers, blinking Marvin.
Repeat each turn.

777-2034-5224-6294.description:
Cast Marketback Walker by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Marketback Walker.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Marketback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Marketback Walker dies, it and Together Forever trigger.
Resolve the Marketback Walker trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Together Forever trigger, returning Marketback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1306-1690-2538-6595.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand that can be cast for {0} due to Lyse Hext.
1306-1690-2538-6595.description:
Activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast an artifact by paying {0}.
Jhoira and Lyse's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Jhoira trigger, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning Mana Crypt to your hand.
Resolve the Lyse trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Mana Crypt by paying {0}.
Jhoira and Lyse's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Jhoira trigger,, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning the artifact cast in step 3 to your hand.
Resolve the Lyse trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
1306-1690-2538-6595.notes: You can use a historic creature to get infinite ETB and LTB triggers. If you do not use a creature, this combo will not produce those results.

requires.n: Creature with MV=1 and Creates Creature Token(s) on Death

2178-5686-6542--110.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with mana value 0.
2178-5686-6542--110.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with mana value 0.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning the creature that creates creature token(s) on death from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, it and Sidisi trigger.
Resolve the Sidisi trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the creature's trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

500-2523-3129-4365.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Mondrak and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put all but one Mondrak token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Ratadrabik triggers four times from the nontoken and token Mondraks dying.
Resolve the first trigger, creating 2^X nonlegendary token copies of Mondrak that are 2/2 Zombies, where X is the number of Mondraks you control plus one.
Repeat step 4 for the remaining triggers.
500-2523-3129-4365.notes: Assuming you control no other token doublers, this combo will make a total of 10^(10^308.0343553279263) creature tokens.

1445-2438-4871-5477.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2438-4871-5477.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1309-2061-4872.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Time Warp each turn.
1309-2061-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Salvager of Secrets.
When the Salvager of Secrets token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4659-5365-5445.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue.
Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Lonis.
4659-5365-5445.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Clue, adding {C}{C}.
Lonis' second ability and Tarrian's Soulcleaver trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Tarrian's Soulcleaver trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Repeat.
4659-5365-5445.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead sacrifice the Clues to their own abilities

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-619-943.description:
Activate Dormant Volcano by tapping it, adding {C}{R}.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Deserted Temple's ability, targeting Dormant Volcano.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Dormant Volcano.
Repeat.
74-619-943.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any other land except Dormant Volcano instead.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Civilized Scholar

1430-3439--51.notablePrerequisites: Mirror Image does not have summoning sickness.
1430-3439--51.description:
Activate Mirror Image using Civilized Scholar's ability by tapping it.
Resolve that ability and choose to modify it with dredge, causing you to mill at least one card, return the creature card with dredge from your graveyard to your hand, then discard that same card, untap Mirror Image and fail to transform it.
Repeat.
1430-3439--51.notes: If your creature with dredge is Golgari Brownscale, this combo also produces near-infinite lifegain and near-infinite lifegain triggers.

413-1754-4766-5683.notablePrerequisites:
All permanents on the battlefield.
Deathrender attached to Guan Yu.
413-1754-4766-5683.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Guan Yu.
When Guan Yu dies, it, Deathrender and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Guan Yu trigger, causing you to shuffle it into your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, causing you to search your library for Guan Yu and put it into your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Guan Yu from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
When Guan Yu enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1308-3398-4076.notablePrerequisites:
You have a full party.
Burakos does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Burakos and Hellkite Charger.
1308-3398-4076.description:
Declare Burakos and Hellkite Charger as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Burakos trigger, creating eight Treasure artifact tokens and causing the defending opponent to lose 4 life.
Activate seven Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

744-1940-2034.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
744-1940-2034.description:
Activate Pegasus Refuge by paying {2} and discarding a card, creating a 1/1 Pegasus creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Pegasus, adding {C}{C}.
When the Pegasus dies, Liliana triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1636-3985-5251.description:
Activate Opposition by tapping Emmara, targeting Emmara.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
The Soldier enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Opposition ability, tapping Emmara.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
The Soldier enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

997-4215-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a green nontoken creature.
997-4215-5220.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a green nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Verdant Succession and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, returning the creature from your library to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

372-2232-4050.manaNeeded: {4}{W} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
372-2232-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five other nonland permanents.
372-2232-4050.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling any six other nonland permanents you control except Cloudstone Curio, and creating six 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Each Soldier enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio that many times.
Resolve the first Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Abdel Adrian from the battlefield to your hand.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, causing all cards exiled with it to return to the battlefield.
If any nonartifact creatures were exiled by Abdel Adrian, they enter the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio that many times.
Resolve all Cloudstone Curio triggers, choosing to return nothing from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing five Soldier tokens, adding {4}{W}.
Repeat.

937-2749-4551.description:
During your upkeep, activate Wall of Blood by paying 1 life, giving Wall of Blood +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat step 1 until you have zero life.
Activate Magus of the Mirror by tapping and sacrificing it, exchanging your life total with an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.
